trigger.failed_constraint: The original seed-53 80/10/10 domain split allowed only 257 IID and 144 domain-balanced grounding examples under the 2% per-domain cap, below the 512-example targets.
trigger.seed_search: Exhaustive deterministic capacity audit over seeds 0-9999 showed no 80/10/10 or 60/20/20 split could meet every registered target.

evaluation_sampling.iid: deterministic natural-composition sampling after sampling-unit caps
evaluation_sampling.domain_balanced: 2% domain cap, application-weighted categories, 5% category floors for action and QA, and 2% floors for grounding
evaluation_sampling.distribution_shift: deterministic natural-composition sampling from held-out generators after sampling-unit caps

rationale: The ladder needs only 100000 examples, so retaining half of eligible domains still leaves ample training capacity while materially strengthening unseen-domain evaluation. The amendment occurs before any EXP005 manifest, model inference, or training freeze.
